tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search the EscortFox directory of independent escorts, agencies and venues in one place. Returns up to 20 listing summaries per page: name, location, age, starting rate, verification status, incall/outcall, venue type, a short teaser and the listing's escortfox.com link. tools.description: Get the summary of one EscortFox listing by its numeric id. tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List the countries that have active EscortFox listings. Returns each country's code (e.g. "DE"), its English name and how many escort and venue listings it has, so you can tell whether the directory covers a place before searching. Use a code as `country` in list_cities and search_listings.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities of a country that have active listings, busiest first. Returns each city's slug, name, state or province, escort and venue counts and its escortfox.com link. tools.name: list_districts
tools.description: List the districts of one city that have active listings. Returns each district's slug, name and escort and venue counts. Most cities have none: an empty list means search the whole city. Use a district slug as `district` in search_listings.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the services escorts can offer on EscortFox. Returns each service's slug and English name (e.g. "massage" = Massage). Use a slug as `service` in search_listings to find escorts who offer it; services apply to escort searches only.
